description: Status of the customer's order in this shop: order status, items, shipping (tracking, pickup point) and payment. Requires the order number and the e-mail the order was placed with, both provided by the customer; never guess them or retry with variations. Repeated failed attempts block verification for a while, also on the shop website; then stop and point the customer to continue_url.

email.description: E-mail address the order was placed with.

order_code.description: Order number exactly as the customer gives it.

name: get_order_status
title: Get Order Status
